material.head: A* setup: wave 2 of wave 3
material.text: Five clean waves up from Mar 19 to Aug 17 (+41%, wave 1). The pullback is under the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (+8.9% to +2.3%), with the 50-day average and the Jan 28 low in the same place. It is the second wave of a larger wave 3: five waves up from May 23, 2025 to Jan 5 and a pullback of 0.75 of them to the Mar 19 low came first, so the end of this wave 2 starts wave 3 of 3, the strongest move a chart makes. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−6%); a close over the wave-1 high (+33%) says wave 3 is under way.
material.learn: After five waves up the pullback usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance; a close turning up there is the buy.
